The affected code is in the zmqsend tool (tools/zmqsend.c). The Debian ffmpeg source already contains the upstream fix, and the zmqsend tool is not built by the default build and is not included in any binary package. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-30999

Debian ffmpeg 7:7.1.5-0+deb13u1 contains the TLS hostname check for numeric hosts that upstream fixed in commit 57a2e704b4a6eda5d061b45aacde6b19c026bfc0; the fix is applied in this build. The mbedTLS backend is not enabled in the Debian build. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-107660
